description: This PHP source file defines a class called Popup_Picker that provides functionalities for rendering a popup-based UI component for selecting 'Releases' records within the SuiteCRM application. The class contains methods for constructing SQL query conditions, generating HTML for the popup interface, and processing list views with search capabilities.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class providing popup interface functionalities for selecting 'Releases' records in SuiteCRM, including search logic, page rendering, and list view management.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs and returns a SQL WHERE clause for filtering 'Releases' records, based on the 'query' parameter in the request.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the popup window, including search input, buttons, and the list of 'Releases' records, handling user interactions and rendering the list view.
